claims.statement: Back in Florence by spring 1500, working at the Servite house of Santissima Annunziata. Fra Pietro da Novellara reports on his work in April 1501.

sources.cite: First chronology draft (Leonardo Chronology, 2026-10-09), entered from model recall. Basis stated in the draft: Novellara letter of 3 April 1501; financial records.
